# Juan Gomez — Software Engineer

> AI-first, full-stack software engineer in Tampa, FL. I build products end to end — the data underneath, the AI in the middle, and the interface people actually touch. Currently building the AI-driven finance platform at Jabil, shipping my own products on the side, and starting an M.S. in Computer Science (Machine Learning) at Georgia Tech in Fall 2026.

This is the personal site and portfolio of Juan Gomez (techbyjuan.com). Bilingual EN/ES. Permanent US Resident — no sponsorship required. Available for one or two new projects a year.

## Selected work

- [Trinity](https://techbyjuan.com): Founding engineer of a production multi-agent AI legal co-pilot for law firms. Architected end to end — case intake & classification, RAG over Colombian jurisprudence, and grounded legal drafting under a strict propose-then-approve human-in-the-loop, with an LLM evaluation harness gating every retrieval and prompt change. Live with pilot firms. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Python, LLMs, RAG, multi-agent.
- [Mia Fit](https://miafit-store.netlify.app): Custom Next.js storefront on a headless commerce backend — full catalog, variants, and cart. Designed, built, and deployed end to end with real products and real checkout in production. Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, headless commerce.
- [Memex](https://getmemex.dev): Open-source npm package giving AI agents persistent, encrypted long-term memory, shipping with an MCP server for plug-and-play use in Claude, ChatGPT, and other LLM tools. Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, npm, MCP.
- [English Woods Publishing](https://englishwoodspublishing.com): Marketing + book site for an independent author and publisher — fast static site with built-in lead capture and a hosted store, shipped on its own domain with a full DNS + SSL cutover. Stack: HTML/CSS/JS, Netlify, Forms.

## Experience

- Jabil — Financial Systems Developer II, Tampa FL (Apr 2025 – Present): Architected and built Jabil Finance's first production AI agent (Snowflake Cortex) — 9 views, 8 semantic models, orchestration, and an evaluation framework — serving 6 global analysts at 96% accuracy against SAP/Cognos source reports. Built a 53+ case AI evaluation suite gating every release, authored A.G.E.N.T. (an internal LLM-agent deployment playbook), and shipped three additional production/MVP apps concurrently (Pillar II tax app, AI File Manager on AWS Bedrock, a Next.js/FastAPI finance platform). Owns end-to-end delivery: release checklists, credential rotation, rollback criteria, row-level access — Okta, Docker, Azure CI/CD.
- Medtronic — Software Engineer I, Minneapolis MN (Mar 2024 – Apr 2025): Built full-stack apps and manufacturing-equipment integrations (Python, Ignition, SECS/GEM), a custom OPC UA device module in Java (Ignition SDK), and a SQL Server normalization redesign — led Validation Plans to FDA/Medtronic quality standards.
- Google Developer Student Club (USF) — Tech Lead, Tampa FL (2023 – 2024): Led the chapter; delivered 10+ technical workshops to 500+ students and mentored 10+ on personal projects.
- Eversana Intouch — Software Development Intern, Kansas City KS (Jun – Aug 2023): Redesigned live client sites for responsiveness and accessibility; built a React + Node.js app that lifted traffic and retention.
